thread:
samir: customer hit a 422 when calling our function-calling API to file a security incident. very upset, says this blocks automated alerting. request id: req_01H8xY
irene: can you paste the exact payload and the API request id?
samir: payload below, from customer webhook:
```json
{"action":"report_security_incident","title":"Possible data exfiltration","severity":"critical","evidence":[{"type":"log","url":"https://logs.example.com/abcd"}],"reported_by":"svc-monitor"}
```
kevin: checked autorouter logs for req_01H8xY — it dispatched to emit_audit_log (tool id: emit_audit_log) with score=0.783. downstream returned schema validation failure because emit_audit_log only accepts {"title","metadata"} and rejects unknown keys.
autorouter-bot: decision: route->emit_audit_log | score=0.783 | reason="title match + high pri" | features={title_overlap:0.9, evidence_token_overlap:0.2}
dylan: reproduced locally: calling report_security_incident with that body results in our router selecting emit_audit_log, then the audit service returns 422: 
```
HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity
{"error":"schema_validation","missing_required":[],"unexpected_fields":["severity","evidence"]}
```
irene: root cause: signature overlap. both tools accept a top-level "title" string; autorouter currently uses a similarity heuristic that overweights short shared fields.
kevin: customer-facing impact: automated alerting pipeline can't file incidents (they get 422) — workaround is to call the namespaced endpoint security.report_security_incident, but not all customers are using namespace. we need a hotfix.
maria-support: created CS-2024-845, informed customer of temporary CLI workaround to call namespaced action. customer requested ETA for fix.
irene: proposed fixes:
- short-term: add a server-side validation layer in autorouter: before dispatching, check target tool's required schema and if caller payload contains required fields for another tool (e.g., severity), refuse emit_audit_log and route to fallback queue or open internal ticket.
- immediate hotfix: lower similarity threshold for title-only matches from 0.8->0.6 and add a rule: if payload contains array "evidence" OR key "severity", prefer tools whose signatures list those keys.
- long-term: require tools to publish explicit required_fields metadata at onboarding time (so autorouter can make deterministic decisions).
kevin: I can push the hotfix to autorouter config (threshold + rule) and add the validation middleware. estimating 2h to roll and verify. want to limit blast radius.
dylan: I'll add a unit/integration test to prevent regressions and write a small harness to fuzz signatures so we can catch future collisions.
kevin: rolling hotfix now. rolling canary to 10% then 50% if metrics look good. deploy-bot: starting deploy autorouter/hotfix-2024-03-01
deploy-bot: canary healthy at 10% after 4m.
kevin: canary looks good, bumped to 50%. monitoring error rate for 422 on router dispatch.
ire ne: note: also adding explicit negative rule: if payload includes "severity" with one of ["critical","high"], do NOT route to emit_audit_log.
samir: customer notified of expected fix window (~2h). thanks.
kevin: full rollout done. monitoring for 30m. current 422s for this path = 0.
maria-support: updated CS-2024-845 and emailed customer, included workaround and root-cause summary.
irene: filing follow-up RFC for tooling onboarding and schema metadata (will link to PR).
samir: great, closing internal thread once CS updated :thumbsup:
kevin: will follow up with postmortem if anything else pops up.
